Thanks for the ping — quick triage notes:

- I reviewed the gateway logs for Sterling's tenant between 08:50–09:20 PT and see repeated 504s coming back from the object-storage presign service. Presign requests are succeeding but then the downstream virus-scan lambda times out intermittently. There's a code path where the UI waits for scan-complete before finishing the upload and doesn't surface a timeout error — it just leaves the spinner running.

- Workaround: we can accept the W9 manually into the vendor profile (upload via the admin console) and mark the document as "verified" so procurement can proceed. That requires a support ticket with the vendor file attached.

- Temporary mitigation: increase scan timeout and instrument a visible error to the UI; I opened SUP-3321 (https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SUP-3321) to track changes.

I've attached a short log snippet showing the presign->scan latency and a suggestion for a 30s bump to the lambda timeout. If Marissa wants, I can perform the manual upload now.

-Ben
Senior Support Engineer, Redwood Inference
